remarks: Welcome to 127 Greyrock Place, Unit 1712, an exceptional 17th-floor TOP floor corner unit at The Biltmore with breathtaking panoramic views of the city skyline and Long Island Sound. This fully updated 2 bedroom, 2 bath residence features over $75,000 in high-end upgrades and a desirable open-concept layout designed for modern living. The renovated kitchen showcases granite countertops, tile backsplash, soft-close shaker cabinetry, and GE stainless steel appliances, seamlessly flowing into the bright living and dining area. Both bedrooms offer ensuite baths, thoughtfully updated with modern finishes, including a fully renovated primary bath with a beautifully tiled walk-in shower. Highlights include wall-to-wall windows that flood the home with natural light, recessed lighting throughout, LVP flooring throughout with new carpet in the bedroom, an in-unit washer/dryer, and smart home features such as Nest thermostats. The Biltmore is a full-service luxury high-rise with 24-hour concierge, fitness center, community room, courtyard, laundry, and additional storage. Pet-friendly with garage parking available at $118/month/car. Ideally located near I95, Metro North, UCONN, theaters, restaurants, coffee shops, farmers market, and just steps from vibrant Bedford St and Pickleball America- an unbeatable combination of luxury living, top-tier amenities, and a prime downtown lifestyle. All current assessments paid in full by the seller! Schedule your tour today!
